START A BUSINESS

Your Claim is the shop location. Registration needs floor, roof, room and entrance.

NPC CONSTRUCTION CONTRACTS

A Workshop can hire an Architect, Builder, Decorator and Inspector. Preview the plan, sign a Coin contract, track the staged queue, or cancel for a rollback and refund.

Connect to the multiplayer server to load construction plans.

PROPERTY RENTALS

Rent complete Properties with a security deposit and recurring Coin payments. Tenants receive private use access while the lease is active.

Connect to the multiplayer server to load rental offers.

GUILD / COMPANY

Create a Company, invite Players, join with an invitation, and connect owned Business Licenses to the Company.

Connect to the multiplayer server to load Companies.

PREMIUM LAND AUCTIONS

Premium Parcels use bid escrow. Outbid Players are refunded automatically; when the timer ends, the winning bid settles into a new Claim.

Connect to the multiplayer server to load Premium auctions.
